message.shippingOne: Status sentence on the homepage. {number} is a GitHub issue/PR number and {title} its GitHub title — both stay exactly as given (never translate the title). Keep the <bdi>…</bdi> tag around them: it isolates the Latin title inside right-to-left text.
message.shippingMany: As message.shippingOne; {more, number} is how many OTHER items shipped in the last 48 hours.
message.liveWithTop: Keep <bdi>#{number} {title}</bdi> intact; the title is a GitHub title and is not translated.
message.liveActive: {hasTop} is 'yes' when there is a current focus item. Translate the clause inside 'yes' as a natural continuation of the sentence; keep <bdi>#{number} {title}</bdi> intact.
message.inProgressBoard: 'tasks' are cards in the owner's GitHub project board 'In Progress' column. Add the plural forms your language needs; keep the hasTop clause and <bdi> as in message.liveActive.
message.inProgressPrsAndIssues: 'open task' here means an open GitHub issue, phrased for a non-technical reader.
message.secondary: Rotates with the primary sentence every ~12 seconds in a single 11px line — keep it short.
headline.inProgress: Not currently displayed; kept for API consumers.
state.shipping: State word in a tiny uppercase instrument label (~12 characters max). The site renders it in CSS uppercase too.
state.idle: Tiny uppercase label, ~12 characters max. Means 'maintenance mode, nothing in flight'.
stateSpoken.inProgress: Spoken (screen-reader) form of the state word, used in announce.status — lower case where your language has case.
pipeline.planning: One of four delivery-pipeline stations: Plan → Build → Ship → Live. One short word each, ~6 characters.
fields.prs: Column label: active GitHub pull requests. Abbreviation is fine; ~8 characters. 'PR' is commonly left untranslated.
fields.pushes24h: Column label: commits pushed in the last 24 hours. ~14 characters.
fields.activity: Column label over a 14-day commit sparkline; {days} is 14 and 'd' abbreviates days.
fields.metered: Shown after 'Sync' when the site is throttling its GitHub polling. Leading '·' is a separator.
sync.hint: {seconds}s — 's' abbreviates seconds. {confidence} is a 0–1 decimal signal-confidence score.
popover.heading: <count></count> is replaced by an animated number — keep the empty tag where the number belongs in your sentence.
popover.openOnGitHub: Tooltip eyebrow on a link that opens GitHub in a new tab. Keep the ↗.
focus.subRow: Single 11px line: '<repo name> · active <time ago>'. <repo></repo> becomes the project name and <age></age> a relative time such as '5 minutes ago' — keep both empty tags and place them as your grammar needs.
queue.hint: ← → are the arrow keys; keep the arrows as-is.
legend.offPipeline: =0 is used when the repository count is unknown. 'repos' = repositories.
announce.counts: Screen-reader sentence; add the plural forms your language needs for each of the three counts.
